selection_policy: Only complete alpha-isolated image-generation components are selected. Repeated visual elements use one best source component plus instances; no rectangular crops from the original art are referenced.

entries.notes: Largest complete golden shell plate; place at the rear and keep rigid. Its open left rim overlaps beneath core_shell to hide the seam.
Medium complete shell plate. Tuck its right edge beneath rear_abdomen_shell and its left rim beneath front_thorax_shell; do not deform the rigid carapace.
Narrow forward shell with two complete socket rims. Use it as the shoulder/thorax transition and overlap the head rear plate by 10-16 source pixels.
Complete generated head, including eye and horns. Rotate only around the concealed neck seam at the rear; never split or rectangular-crop this component.
Smaller upward golden mandible. Align its circular root under the head cheek; use a short snap rather than translation for attack.
Larger lower golden mandible. Its root ring must remain underneath the cheek/socket cover while the tip stays in front of the upper mandible.
Complete thorned olive proximal claw segment. Keep the shell-side ring underneath the socket overlay and rotate at the root only.
Complete dark distal claw/foot with a clean root ring. The ring overlaps beneath the proximal segment by 6-10 source pixels to prevent a transparent gap.
One clean generated upper-leg component is intentionally instanced three times; the near-duplicates part_026-part_029 are rejected because they bake multiple joints into one sprite.
Use the complete lower segment and its painted foot as a rigid distal element. Instance it for all three walking legs with the listed perspective scales.
Single best large olive socket ring. Keep each instance shell-attached and above the limb root to mask rotation seams.
Small clean ring selected over the many duplicate rings. Parent it to the proximal element so it covers the distal root throughout motion.
Best clean white capsule is reused with perspective scale for both complete antenna chains. This preserves a stable contour and avoids mixing the near-duplicate oval variants.

One gray connector is instanced at every capsule joint and drawn directly behind the capsules. Duplicate connector components part_021/024/025/031/032/034/035/038/040/050/051 are deliberately omitted.
Complete magenta front membrane plate; keep it behind head, crest and green shell plates, with its root hidden beneath front_shell.
Second complete magenta plate; overlap the previous membrane and place beneath the leading green carapace.
Third complete membrane plate. A small overlap under mid_shell is required so shell rocking never reveals background.
Rear complete magenta membrane. It sits behind the egg sac and both rear shell panels; keep its lower arc visible between leg sockets.
Complete orange egg cluster. Preserve the rendered eggs as one organic mass and animate only restrained breathing/weight transfer, never per-egg random motion.
Broad complete green plate with two integrated teal gems; align those gems near source (695,82) and (638,181). Do not add duplicate gem overlays there.
Tall complete gemless middle plate. Its forward rim overlaps under front_shell; use large_gem_template for the exposed mid gem.
Complete curved rear-upper plate with one integrated teal gem; align the embedded gem near source (1205,95) and overlap its lower edge over the egg sac.
Narrow complete gemless tail plate. Place behind rear_upper_shell and add the small tail gem from small_gem_template at the exposed outer edge.
Complete green head shell. Its rear edge overlaps crest/membrane roots; eye, mandibles and small gems remain separate foreground attachments.
Complete isolated eye. Parent it rigidly to Head; a tiny eyelid/squash accent is acceptable, but never translate it independently across the face.
Smaller upper orange mandible; conceal the circular root beneath the head lip and animate a firm pincer arc.
Larger lower orange mandible. Keep the tip in front of the upper mandible and use opposing rotation around the cheek attachment.
Tall complete rear crest leaf. Root is buried behind head shell; use only low-amplitude delayed rotation.
Second complete crest leaf; overlap leaf_01 and leaf_03 by painted edges so wind-up motion cannot open black seams.
Third complete crest leaf; this is the visual rhythm leader for the crest follow-through.
Fourth complete crest leaf; preserve its pointed silhouette and keep it behind the head brow.
Fifth complete crest leaf; smaller perspective scale makes the crest taper naturally into the thorax.
Smallest complete front crest leaf; tuck most of its root beneath head/front-shell art and let it lag the larger leaves by one short beat.
Best large teal gem reused twice. Gems already painted into part_010 and part_012 are not duplicated.
One high-quality small gem is scaled for the remaining crest/head/tail placements. Duplicate gem components part_019-part_021 and part_029-part_038 are intentionally omitted.

Best complete green socket/upper-leg component selected once and instanced for all five legs. Near-duplicate root assemblies part_022-part_024 and part_026 are omitted; shell-side overlap is hidden by the socket template.
Best clean straight middle segment selected once. Near-duplicates part_039, part_040, part_042 and part_043 are omitted; instance scale/rotation preserves each leg silhouette.
Best complete bent distal/foot component selected once. Near-duplicates part_044, part_045, part_047 and part_048 are omitted; pin its upper knuckle to each middle segment.
Best complete root ring selected once and kept shell-attached for all five instances. Duplicate rings part_049 and part_051-part_053 are omitted.
